verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.truelayer.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 as a structured index, and it tells agents to append .md to any docs page for a markdown version. Many cited doc URLs are indeed served as .md pages, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or consolidated agent-oriented bundle, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).
